title: lavandula angustifolia subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Lavandula angustifolia subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean lavender or narrow-leaved lavender, is a subspecies of the flowering plant Lavandula angustifolia, native to the Pyrenees mountains. This plant is valued for its calming and soothing properties, with potential health benefits including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress. The therapeutic actions of Pyrenean lavender include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antiseptic properties, which can also help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which are responsible for its calming and anti-inflammatory effects.
